LightningComponentBundle.description: A record's engagement in time order (Contacts, Accounts and person accounts): the sources set up in Time Trail Setup, Data 360 ones included. Vertical in narrow regions, horizontal in wide ones.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Title
property.description: The timeline's name for screen readers (the view's name is the visible heading).

property.name: layout
property.label: Layout
property.description: Auto is vertical in narrow regions and horizontal from 640px wide.

property.name: openAt
property.label: Open At
property.description: Where the timeline opens: Today (today's slot, with a placeholder when it has nothing), its earliest item or its latest. Vertical lists the newest at the top; horizontal runs earliest to latest.

property.name: activityActionsMode
property.label: Activity Actions
property.description: The record's activity actions (New Task, New Event, Log a Call, Email), as the page layout's Activity composer offers them. None shows nothing; One button folds them into a + menu; Inline shows a button each among the filter buttons; Full shows a button each with its name, on a line above the header (beside the buttons in a wide horizontal card).

property.name: showAge
property.label: Show Age
property.description: Each item says how long ago it was (3 days ago) beside its time.

property.name: itemDetail
property.label: Item Detail
property.description: Max shows each item's time and date beside its title. Lite shows only the title and subtitle. People can switch with the button after Today; their choice is remembered in their browser.

property.name: density
property.label: Display Density
property.description: Auto follows each user's Comfy or Compact setting. Comfy or Compact overrides it for this component.

property.name: historyYears
property.label: History (years)
property.description: How far back the timeline plots: 0.25 (3 months) to 10 years.

property.name: futureYears
property.label: Future (years)
property.description: How far ahead the timeline plots future-dated records (scheduled orders, close dates): None (up to today), or 0.25 to 10 years.

property.name: horizontalHeight
property.label: Horizontal Mode Height (px)
property.description: Horizontal layout only: the height of the day columns. Days with more events scroll inside their column, so the card keeps one height.

property.name: phoneHeight
property.label: Phone Mode Height (px)
property.description: Salesforce mobile app on a phone only: the list's greatest height. Blank fits the screen, whatever the phone, and follows rotating it. Place Time Trail high on the page, or in a tab of its own, for the best fit.

property.name: verticalHeight
property.label: Vertical Mode Height (px)
property.description: Vertical layout only: the list's greatest height. With a few days the list is as tall as they are; past this, items scroll inside it.
